answer.says: Shri Hegde, I have been observing the machinery of the Directorate with some interest. The confusion of our names has revealed more about the nature of bureaucracy than any of my lectures have. Ramesh, I must speak with you regarding the state of the household and my obligations to you.
answer.thought: Hegde is present, a living contradiction to my own administrative existence. I must address the practical crisis of my sustenance and the debt I owe to Ramesh, while observing how this accidental cohabitation mirrors the entanglement of the individual and the state. The evening is quiet, but the tensions in the room are taut.
